value: The BP swap, first since the 12A died (D-616): a JDM Miata BP 1.8 and its 5-speed in the 1982 FB (D-629), trusted as delivered (D-640), built lean (D-641) and turbo-ready where it is cheap (D-630) - wave 1 gets the car running, driving and registered on the EMU Black (D-642) with the electrical project's wave 1; the turbo stage and the luxury stage (show finish, power steering, A/C) come later
